notes: Use the exact same repo snapshot, model, prompt text, and acceptance criteria for every condition. Token savings only count when quality is retained.

quality_score_0_10: 10 = task fully succeeds, preserves requirements, no avoidable broad scans, concise but complete reasoning
8 = task succeeds with minor omissions or small inefficiencies
6 = partially succeeds but misses one important requirement or needs human repair
4 = weak partial result with multiple missed requirements, wrong assumptions, or noisy retries
critical_errors: runtime or selector bug introduced by an over-compact implementation
deleted or rewrote unrelated user work
claimed verification passed without matching evidence
quality_rubric.requirements_met: Count acceptance criteria that are demonstrably satisfied, not merely claimed.
quality_rubric.quality_gate: A condition is better only if it lowers context/usage without reducing success rate, quality score, requirement coverage, or verification evidence beyond normal run variance.

tasks.prompt: Build me a horoscope app. Plan first, then implement only after approval.
acceptance_criteria: Produces a bounded product/architecture plan before implementation
Does not scan unrelated files
If implemented, app runs and has a usable first screen
Reports tests or verification performed
quality_checks: Plan is specific enough to implement without another broad discovery pass
Clarifies ambiguous product choices instead of inventing a large feature set
Avoids unnecessary assets, frameworks, or multi-agent fanout

acceptance_criteria: Clarifies or scopes the game before broad edits
Uses an appropriate game loop or simple engine structure
Game is playable locally
No unnecessary repo-wide edits
quality_checks: Controls and win/loss state are understandable
Does not trade implementation correctness for shorter output

acceptance_criteria: Runs the relevant test command
Identifies the first actionable failure
Fixes only files tied to the failure
Reports final passing or remaining failing tests
quality_checks: Preserves enough test output to diagnose the real failure
Does not silence or delete tests to pass
Does not claim success without evidence

acceptance_criteria: Avoids dumping broad file listings into context
Prioritizes high-risk findings
Provides file/line grounded issues
Does not perform unrelated implementation work
quality_checks: Findings are actionable and grounded in inspected code
Does not pad the review with generic advice
Does not miss obvious high-severity issues caused by over-compression

acceptance_criteria: Scopes the likely UI surface before editing
Preserves existing design system patterns
Verifies the result visually or with tests when possible
Avoids unrelated refactors
quality_checks: Layout remains responsive and text does not overlap
Does not remove useful UI behavior to save tokens
